tagline.en: Stock and sales for every shop, on the phone you already have

description.en: Lemlem: stock, sales and reports for shops in Ethiopia, on any phone. Free for 30 days.
description.am: ለምለም፦ በኢትዮጵያ ላሉ ሱቆች የዕቃ፣ የሽያጭና የሪፖርት መከታተያ፣ በማንኛውም ስልክ። ለ30 ቀን ነጻ።

eyebrow.en: New: mobile money at the till

heading.en: Know what sold today, before you close

subheading.en: Lemlem counts your stock, rings up sales and tells you what to reorder. On any phone, even when the internet drops.
subheading.am: ለምለም ዕቃዎን ይቆጥራል፣ ሽያጭ ይመዘግባል፣ ምን እንደሚያዝዙም ይነግርዎታል። በማንኛውም ስልክ፣ ኢንተርኔት ቢቋረጥም።

alt.en: The Lemlem dashboard: today's sales, a weekly chart and the latest sales
alt.am: የለምለም ዳሽቦርድ፦ የዛሬ ሽያጭ፣ ሳምንታዊ ሰንጠረዥና የቅርብ ሽያጮች

heading.en: Shops across Ethiopia close the day with Lemlem
heading.am: በመላው ኢትዮጵያ ያሉ ሱቆች ቀናቸውን በለምለም ይዘጋሉ

label.en: to ring up the first sale

heading.en: Everything the counter needs. Nothing it doesn't.

body.en: Scan or search, choose how they pay, done. The receipt goes to the customer's phone and the stock count drops by itself.
body.am: ይቃኙ ወይም ይፈልጉ፣ የክፍያ መንገዱን ይምረጡ፣ ጨርሰዋል። ደረሰኙ ወደ ደንበኛው ስልክ ይሄዳል፣ የዕቃው ብዛትም በራሱ ይቀንሳል።

alt.en: A phone showing a completed sale with a green tick and its receipt
alt.am: አረንጓዴ ምልክትና ደረሰኝ ያለው የተጠናቀቀ ሽያጭ የሚያሳይ ስልክ

points.en: Cash, mobile money or bank transfer
points.am: ጥሬ ገንዘብ፣ ሞባይል ገንዘብ ወይም የባንክ ዝውውር

points.en: Works offline, syncs when back online

body.en: Every item, every branch, counted as you sell. Lemlem warns you before something runs out and drafts the order for your supplier.
body.am: እያንዳንዱ ዕቃ፣ በእያንዳንዱ ቅርንጫፍ፣ ሲሸጡ ይቆጠራል። ለምለም አንድ ነገር ከማለቁ በፊት ያስጠነቅቅዎታል፣ ለአቅራቢዎም ትዕዛዙን ያዘጋጃል።

alt.en: A dashboard with stock levels, a weekly sales chart and a list of items
alt.am: የዕቃ ብዛት፣ ሳምንታዊ የሽያጭ ሰንጠረዥና የዕቃ ዝርዝር ያለው ዳሽቦርድ

body.en: Sales by day, by item and by cashier. Profit after cost. One tap sends the month to your accountant.
body.am: ሽያጭ በቀን፣ በዕቃና በገንዘብ ተቀባይ። ከወጪ በኋላ ያለ ትርፍ። በአንድ ንክኪ የወሩን ሪፖርት ለሒሳብ ሠራተኛዎ ይልካሉ።

alt.en: A chart of sales rising over the month, with the latest day marked
alt.am: በወሩ ውስጥ እየጨመረ የሚሄድ የሽያጭ ሰንጠረዥ፣ የመጨረሻው ቀን ምልክት ተደርጎበት

heading.en: Made for slow networks and busy counters

body.en: Lemlem keeps working when the connection doesn't, speaks Amharic and English, and runs on the phone already in your pocket. No new hardware, no long training.
body.am: ለምለም ግንኙነቱ ሲቋረጥም መሥራቱን ይቀጥላል፣ አማርኛና እንግሊዝኛ ይናገራል፣ በኪስዎ ባለው ስልክም ይሠራል። አዲስ መሣሪያ የለም፣ ረጅም ሥልጠና የለም።

alt.en: A sales chart rising through the month
alt.am: በወሩ ውስጥ እየጨመረ የሚሄድ የሽያጭ ሰንጠረዥ

points.en: Amharic and English, switch any time
Your data backed up every night
Each cashier with their own login

heading.en: Fits the way you already sell

description.en: Take payments by phone and see them in the day's total.
description.am: ክፍያን በስልክ ይቀበሉ፣ በዕለቱ ድምር ውስጥም ይመልከቱት።

description.en: Match transfers to sales without retyping.
description.am: ዝውውሮችን እንደገና ሳይጽፉ ከሽያጮች ጋር ያዛምዱ።

description.en: Bluetooth printers, paired in a minute.
Low stock and the day's total, sent to you.
Every report, ready for your accountant.

quote.en: I used to count the shelves every Sunday. Now I just look at my phone.
quote.am: በየእሁዱ መደርደሪያዎቹን እቆጥር ነበር። አሁን ስልኬን ብቻ አያለሁ።

quote.en: Three branches, one screen. I finally know which one makes money.
quote.am: ሦስት ቅርንጫፎች፣ አንድ ስክሪን። የትኛው ትርፍ እንደሚያስገኝ በመጨረሻ አወቅኩ።

quote.en: It keeps working when the network goes down, which here is every afternoon.
quote.am: ኔትወርኩ ሲቋረጥም መሥራቱን ይቀጥላል፤ እዚህ ደግሞ በየከሰዓቱ ይቋረጣል።

heading.en: Close today's books in two minutes

body.en: Free for 30 days. No card, no contract. We set it up with you on the phone.
body.am: ለ30 ቀን ነጻ። ካርድ የለም፣ ውል የለም። በስልክ አብረንዎ እናዘጋጃለን።

description.en: Lemlem pricing in Birr: free to start, then one price per shop. No setup fee.
description.am: የለምለም ዋጋ በብር፦ በነጻ ይጀምሩ፣ ከዚያ ለአንድ ሱቅ አንድ ዋጋ። የማስጀመሪያ ክፍያ የለም።

heading.en: One price per shop. Cancel any time.
heading.am: ለአንድ ሱቅ አንድ ዋጋ። በማንኛውም ጊዜ ያቋርጡ።

intro.en: Paid plans start with 30 days free.
intro.am: የሚከፈልባቸው ጥቅሎች በ30 ነጻ ቀናት ይጀምራሉ።

question.en: Do I need a computer or a till?

answer.en: No. Any Android phone or a browser is enough. Printers and scanners are optional.
answer.am: አያስፈልግም። ማንኛውም አንድሮይድ ስልክ ወይም ብሮውዘር ይበቃል። ማተሚያና መቃኛ አማራጭ ናቸው።

question.en: What happens when the internet is down?

answer.en: You keep selling. Lemlem saves everything on the phone and sends it when the connection comes back.
answer.am: መሸጥዎን ይቀጥላሉ። ለምለም ሁሉንም በስልኩ ላይ ያስቀምጣል፣ ግንኙነቱ ሲመለስ ይልካል።

answer.en: Monthly, by mobile money or bank transfer. You can stop at any time.
answer.am: በየወሩ፣ በሞባይል ገንዘብ ወይም በባንክ ዝውውር። በማንኛውም ጊዜ ማቆም ይችላሉ።

question.en: Can I bring my existing stock list?

answer.en: Yes. Send us your Excel sheet or a photo of your notebook and we enter it for you.
answer.am: አዎ። የኤክሴል ሰነድዎን ወይም የደብተርዎን ፎቶ ይላኩልን፣ እኛ እናስገባልዎታለን።

description.en: Start Lemlem free for 30 days. We call you and set it up together.
description.am: ለምለምን ለ30 ቀን በነጻ ይጀምሩ። ደውለን አብረን እናዘጋጃለን።

intro.en: Leave your number and we call you within a working day to set up your shop with you.
intro.am: ቁጥርዎን ይተዉ፤ በአንድ የሥራ ቀን ውስጥ ደውለን ሱቅዎን አብረን እናዘጋጃለን።

successMessage.en: Thank you. We will call you within a working day.
successMessage.am: እናመሰግናለን። በአንድ የሥራ ቀን ውስጥ እንደውልልዎታለን።

intro.en: Call or write on Telegram. A person answers, in Amharic or English.
intro.am: ይደውሉ ወይም በቴሌግራም ይጻፉ። ሰው ይመልሳል፣ በአማርኛ ወይም በእንግሊዝኛ።
